mapper.select: SELECT no, title, content, writer, reg_date as regDate, update_date as updateDate FROM tbl_board_ex ORDER BY no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_board_ex (title, content, writer) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_board_ex SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, writer = #{writer}, update_date = NOW() WHERE no = #{no}
